page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.medium is a general-purpose virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 2 dedicated physical cores and 2 vCPUs, providing a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio. It includes 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, and it has a baseline network bandwidth of 0 Gbps.

Benchmark results place the ecs.sn2.medium in the lower performance tiers. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance score of 1100.09 falls into the bottom 25%, while the multi-core score of 1460.39 is in the bottom 10%. Memory bandwidth tests show poor throughput, with read-only large block speeds at 10.22 GB/sec and write large block speeds at 9.28 GB/sec. Geekbench metrics, including a single-core score of 911.0 and a multi-core score of 1075.0, consistently rank in the bottom 10% across text processing, image processing, and software compilation workloads.

The primary tradeoff of this instance is its low performance density relative to its dedicated CPU allocation. While it offers dedicated Intel Xeon cores with AVX and AVX512F instruction support, its actual execution speeds in database operations, encryption, and compression are limited, as evidenced by a Passmark database score of 543.02 and a Redis SET performance of 1.42 million operations per second. Consequently, this instance is best suited for low-intensity general-purpose workloads, basic web serving, or lightweight development and testing environments that do not require high network throughput or local storage.
